verdict.rationale: Stripe explicitly documents a synchronous webhook for real-time authorization approve/decline decisions (stripe-issuing-docs-4), directly matching the core of the story. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of the fallback behavior (e.g., default approve/decline when the webhook times out) or how a developer can configure/control that fallback, which is a key part of the story. Missing for 10: documented timeout window/budget, explicit fallback decision behavior, and developer-configurable fallback settings.
